capabilities: Replace native file, tab and editor context menus with configurable grouped icon menus
Run editor text actions via regex, preset transforms, pipelines and recorded keystrokes
Send selected text to an OpenAI-compatible AI and copy, insert or replace results
Color and bold filenames in the file explorer
Style menus with 27 color themes and 12 button styles
disambiguation: Not just a file operations tool; it also provides editor context menus, AI text processing, a stash panel and full menu appearance customization.
extras: Desktop only (minimum Obsidian 1.2.7), Chinese/English interface, and the listing notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian's native context menus are fixed and offer few file or text operations, so users cannot customize or extend what right-click actions are available.
summary: Configurable icon-based context menus for file explorer, tabs and editor, adding file operations, text transforms, AI processing and menu theming.
